name: When should luxury fixture selections be finalized before construction starts?

mainEntity.name: How early do premium fixtures and materials need to be chosen to avoid schedule problems?
mainEntity.text: How early do premium fixtures and materials need to be chosen to avoid schedule problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury selections should be finalized early because the products often affect the build itself. Fixture dimensions can change plumbing rough-ins, lighting placement, cabinet spacing, and wall details. Stone and tile selections can affect substrate prep, thickness transitions, and layout decisions. Waiting too long can force the installer to adjust work that is already in progress, which increases cost and delay. In practice, homeowners should aim to choose the core materials before rough-in milestones are locked in. That gives the team enough time to verify technical details, order special items, and coordinate fabrication. The earlier the selections are made, the easier it is to avoid substitutions or rushed decisions that compromise the final finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury fixtures and materials should be finalized as early as possible, usually before demolition or rough-in work begins. Early selection helps confirm dimensions, rough-in locations, lead times, and compatibility, which reduces rework and costly delays later in the project.
